messages:
Priya Rao: Quick heads-up — noticed per-route KPIs in Console are missing token-level latency breakdowns. We have p50/p95/p99 and throughput, but no split across queue/tokenization/model/kernel/kv-cache/postprocess. That makes triage after the kernel-selector v2 rollout painful. Anyone working on a dashboard plan?

Diego Martinez: Yup, saw p99 spikes on a handful of routes after v2. I have some profiling dumps. Agree we need token-level slices. I can add metrics, but want to confirm exact labels/queries we want in Console.

Alyssa Chen: Recommended dashboard items per-route: tokens/sec, requests/sec, p50/p95/p99 (total) + token-level breakdown (queue, tokenization, model_compute, kernel, kv_cache, postprocess). Also error rate and per-route batch_size percentiles. Small widgets for quick scan, then expandable detail.

Diego Martinez: Draft metric queries (PromQL-style) to start with:
```
# throughput tokens/sec per route
sum by(route) (rate(redwood_tokens_emitted_total[1m]))

# p95 token latency per route using histogram
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))

# error rate per route
sum by(route) (rate(redwood_route_errors_total[5m])) / sum by(route) (rate(redwood_requests_total[5m]))
```
I'll wire the metric names into the exporter.

Priya Rao: Important: KV cache metrics must be tagged per-route and per-model-variant. Right now `redwood_kv_cache_*` is global. We need `route=...` and `model_variant=...` to correlate hit-rate with latency.

Alyssa Chen: Also capture batch_size distribution per-route (p50/p90/p99). If kernel selector changes the batching heuristics, we can see whether bigger batches correlate with higher p99s.

Diego Martinez: Plan: expose these new metrics: `redwood_route_token_latency_seconds_bucket`, `redwood_route_token_latency_seconds_sum`, `redwood_route_token_latency_seconds_count`, `redwood_route_batch_size_summary`, `redwood_route_kv_cache_hits_total` with labels `{route, model, variant, kernel, stage}`. Will add label `chosen_kernel` for kernel selector.

console-bot: dashboard 'per-route-kpis-v1' deployed to staging by Diego Martinez at 1718923560 :rocket:

Priya Rao: Nice. Can you paste an example token-level breakdown query that Console can use for the stacked bar? I want queue vs tokenization vs model vs kv cache.

Diego Martinez: Example (per-route, stacked by stage):
```
# average token latency per stage
sum by(route, stage) (rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_sum[5m])) / sum by(route, stage) (rate(redwood_token_latency_seconds_count[5m]))
```
Stages will be labels: `queue`, `tokenize`, `model_compute`, `kernel_exec`, `kv_cache`, `postprocess`.

Alyssa Chen: Alerting suggestion: p99 > 1.2s for 5m -> page oncall + attach latest profile link. Also a warning-level on kv_cache_hit_rate < 0.8 for any high-throughput route.

Priya Rao: Can we include a small annotation in dashboards to link to the last stored profile / perf dump for that route (so engineers can click and open the flamegraph)?

Diego Martinez: Good idea. I'll add `profile_url` field to route metrics exporter as an exemplar label only for annotations (or Console can build the link from route+ts).

Sam Brooks: I'll review the widget layout tomorrow. Quick UX ask — keep each row compact so we can show ~40 routes per page. Consider a compact sparkline + single-number p95/p99 + tiny stacked bar for token breakdown.

Priya Rao: Who's owning rollout? Proposed: enable KV per-route tags in staging for 24h, observe, then enable in prod canary with 10% traffic.

Diego Martinez: I created PR: https://git.internal/redwood/metrics/pulls/184 — implements new metrics + chosen_kernel label + basic dashboard JSON. Ran perf test suite, attached results in PR.

Priya Rao: Tiny profiling snippet from last night to illustrate problem: `kernel=v2, route=/chat/basic, p99=1.4s, kv_hit_rate=0.87, avg_batch=8` — p99 correlates with kernel_exec latency.

Alyssa Chen: If kernel_exec is the dominant tail contributor, we should expose `kernel_latency_seconds_bucket{kernel,route}` and add a per-kernel comparison widget to spot regressions quickly.

Diego Martinez: Will instrument `kernel_latency_seconds_bucket` and export per-kernel meta like `quantiles` in the summary metric. Also adding `fallback=true/false` label when we switch to a compatible variant.

Priya Rao: @Sam Brooks can you take a look at the staging dashboard after Diego's PR lands and sanity-check widget sizes + alert thresholds?

Sam Brooks: Yep, I'll get to it first thing. Also suggest adding a very small 'explain' tooltip for each metric so on-call knows what the slices mean.

observability-bot: Note: Added dashboard ownership tag -> team:eng-runtime; notification channel -> #eng-runtime-observability.

Priya Rao: Great work. After Sam's review we'll schedule a canary for next week and run the perf-presubmit harness against the new metrics. Thanks all.

Diego Martinez: Thanks — will follow up in the PR with staging links and a short runbook for triage steps.
